query: dfki dkt at semeval 2017 task 8 rumour detection and classification using cascading heuristics
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.venue,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
WHERE
  p.year = 2017
  AND (
    (p.title ILIKE '%semeval%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%semeval%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%task 8%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%task 8%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%rumour%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%rumour%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%detection%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%detection%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%classification%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%classification%')
  )
ORDER BY
  (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%dfki%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%dfki%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%dkt%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%dkt%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%semeval 2017%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%semeval 2017%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%task 8%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%task 8%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%rumour detection%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%rumour detection%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%rumour%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%rumour%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%classification%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%classification%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
  ) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100

sql:

  p.title,
  p.abstract,

      p.abstract ILIKE '%neural sequence%' OR
      p.title ILIKE '%sequence prediction%' OR
      p.abstract ILIKE '%sequence prediction%'

    WHEN p.title ILIKE '%generative bridging network%' THEN 2
    WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%generative bridging network for neural sequence prediction%' THEN 3
    WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%generative bridging network%' THEN 4
    ELSE 5
  END,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100

query: using gazetteers in discriminative information extraction
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.citation_count,
  p.year
FROM Papers p
WHERE
  (
    (p.title ILIKE '%gazetteer%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%gazetteer%')
    OR (p.title ILIKE '%gazetteers%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%gazetteers%')
  )
  AND (
    p.title ILIKE '%discriminative%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%discriminative%'
    OR p.title ILIKE '%conditional random field%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%conditional random field%'
    OR p.title ILIKE '%crf%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%crf%'
    OR p.title ILIKE '%maxent%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%maxent%'
    OR p.title ILIKE '%maximum entropy%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%maximum entropy%'
    OR p.title ILIKE '%log-linear%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%log-linear%'
  )
  AND (
    p.title ILIKE '%information extraction%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%information extraction%'
    OR p.title ILIKE '%named entity recognition%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%named entity recognition%'
    OR p.title ILIKE '%ner%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%ner%'
  )
ORDER BY
  (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%gazetteer%' OR p.title ILIKE '%gazetteers%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%discriminative%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%information extraction%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%gazetteer%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%gazetteers%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC,
  p.year DESC
LIMIT 100

query: select answer and explain interpretable multi hop reading comprehension over multiple documents
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
WHERE
  (
    to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.title, '') || ' ' || coalesce(p.abstract, ''))
    @@ plainto_tsquery('english',
      'select & answer & explain & interpretable & "multi hop" & "multi-hop" & "reading comprehension" & "multi document" & "multi-document"'
    )
  )
  OR (
    lower(p.title) LIKE '%multi hop%'
    OR lower(p.title) LIKE '%multi-hop%'
    OR lower(p.title) LIKE '%multi document%'
    OR lower(p.title) LIKE '%multi-document%'
    OR lower(p.title) LIKE '%reading comprehension%'
    OR lower(p.title) LIKE '%question answering%'
  )
ORDER BY
  ts_rank_cd(
    to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.title, '') || ' ' || coalesce(p.abstract, '')),
    plainto_tsquery('english',
      'select & answer & explain & interpretable & "multi hop" & "multi-hop" & "reading comprehension" & "multi document" & "multi-document"'
    )
  ) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC NULLS LAST,
  p.year DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100

    title ILIKE '%generalisation%' OR
    title ILIKE '%adaptive gradient%' OR

    abstract ILIKE '%adam%' OR

    )
  ) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100

  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.venue,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count
FROM Papers p

    OR (p.title ILIKE '%roll-call vote%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%roll-call vote%')
    OR (p.title ILIKE '%rollcall vote%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%rollcall vote%')

    OR p.title ILIKE '%representation learning%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%representation learning%'
    OR p.title ILIKE '%vector%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%vector%'
    OR p.title ILIKE '%neural%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%neural%'
    OR p.title ILIKE '%deep learning%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%deep learning%'
    OR p.title ILIKE '%prediction%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%prediction%'
    OR p.title ILIKE '%predicting%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%predicting%'
    OR p.title ILIKE '%classification%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%classification%'
  )
ORDER BY
  (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%roll call vote%' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%roll call vote%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +

  (CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%class prior estimation%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%positive and unlabeled%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%positive and unlabeled%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,

  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,

    p.title ILIKE '%word substitution%' OR
    p.abstract ILIKE '%word substitution%'
  )
  OR (

    p.title ILIKE '%context overlap%' OR

    p.title ILIKE '%contextual similarity%' OR

    (CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%distributional similarity%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
    (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%word substitution%' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END) +

query: text simplification as tree labeling
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.citation_count,
  p.year
FROM Papers p
WHERE
  (
    (p.title ILIKE '%text simplification%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%text simplification%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%tree%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%tree%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%label%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%label%')
  )
  OR (
    (p.title ILIKE '%simplification%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%simplification%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%tree labeling%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%tree labeling%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%tree labelling%' OR p.title ILIKE '%tree labelling%')
  )
ORDER BY
  (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%text simplification as tree labeling%' THEN 4 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%text simplification%' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%text simplification%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%tree labeling%' OR p.title ILIKE '%tree labelling%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%tree labeling%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%tree labelling%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100

query: entyfi a system for fine grained entity typing in fictional texts

SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,

FROM Papers p
WHERE

    AND (p.title ILIKE '%fiction%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%fiction%')
  )

    WHEN p.title ILIKE '%entyfi%' THEN 2
    WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%entyfi%' THEN 3
    WHEN (p.title ILIKE '%fine grained entity typing%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%fine grained entity typing%')
         AND (p.title ILIKE '%fiction%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%fiction%') THEN 4
    ELSE 5
  END,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100
